about.title: Visalia Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a death in Visalia is the result of someone else's carelessness, the people left behind carry more than grief. Bills arrive, income stops, and questions go unanswered. A wrongful death claim is the civil path California provides for those questions, separate from any criminal case and focused on what your family lost. In 2025, Visalia recorded 8 traffic deaths among 411 injury collisions, with much of the city's collision volume falling along SR-198, S Mooney Boulevard, Rt 63 and S Demaree Street. Not every fatal event happens on the road, though. Workplace accidents, unsafe premises, and medical errors can also give rise to a claim. Under California law, a spouse or domestic partner and children have first standing, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and shorter when a government entity is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Tulare County families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Visalia Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases, starting with a spouse or domestic partner and children, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out quickly whether you are eligible to bring a claim.

items.title: Deadlines Explained Early
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, but that window shrinks when a public entity is involved. Getting connected early protects your right to act.

items.title: The Full Picture of Loss
items.desc: Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial costs to lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. Your attorney will work to account for each of these, with no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on SR-198 near Visalia. Does the criminal case decide our claim?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that stands on its own, regardless of whether the other driver is charged or convicted. The civil case uses a different standard of proof and addresses your family's losses rather than punishment. An attorney can pursue it while any criminal matter runs its course.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, two years from the date of death. If a city, county, or state agency may be responsible, a separate government claim must be filed much sooner, often within six months. Because those timelines are strict, it helps to speak with an attorney well before either deadline approaches.

items.question: Does it cost anything to use LawProactive or to hire the attorney?
items.answer: Our connection service is free, and we are not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on a contingency basis, meaning there is no attorney fee unless your family obtains a recovery. Your first conversation is an opportunity to ask questions without pressure.
